newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Turkmenistan cuts gas supplies to Ukraine - Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Turkmenistan cuts gas supplies to Ukraine - Interfax.

text.p: The Central Asian state of Turkmenistan cut all gas supplies to Ukraine this week because of unpaid bills, Interfax-Ukraine news agency quoted Turkmen President Saparmurat Niyazov as saying Friday.
Niyazov told a group of Ukrainian journalists in Moscow that all supplies were stopped on Wednesday.
"This was not Ukraine's fault, but rather those companies supplying gas to Ukraine from Turkmenistan," he said.
A duty officer at Ukraine's State Gas and Oil Committee confirmed a drop over the last three days to 15 million cubic metres from 50 million cubic metres.
The 15 million cubic metres was supplied by Uzbekistan, another Central Asian state, he said.
Company officials from the Itera-Ukraine company, which was appointed by the Ukrainian government to supply Turkmen gas and which has some U.S. capital, were not available for comment.
This year Kiev is due to import six to eight billion cubic metres of Turkmen gas, in addition to 53 billion cubic metres from Russia and 4.5 billion cubic metres from Uzbekistan.
